raw_text: The Indian Army's annual winter exercise Himgiri Prahar commenced on March 8 in Ladakh as scheduled, the Defence Ministry confirmed on Sunday after social media speculation about troop mobilisation near the LAC. A senior official stated that all movements were part of the pre-announced exercise programme and that China had been notified through established military channels as per protocol. The exercise tests cold-weather combat readiness and involves approximately 15,000 troops from XIV Corps.
